# runbooks/ — what belongs here

## Belongs here

- A procedure someone follows under pressure, or one where a step needs a
  judgement call that must not be automated (kiln ADR-0007).

## Does not belong here

| Instead of                       | Put it in    |
| -------------------------------- | ------------ |
| A routine development activity   | `guides/`    |
| A one-off plan                   | `specs/`     |

## Naming and shape

- One kebab-case `.md` per procedure, written as ordered steps with the
  decision points called out.
